text:
# Responsible 
Gambling
Effective date: 3 August 2026
### 1. 
Our commitment
LIQD LTD operates liqd.bet under B2C gaming licence No. ALSI-202603048-FI2, issued by the Government of the Autonomous Island of Anjouan, Union of Comoros.
Gambling should be an enjoyable form of entertainment. It is not a way to make money, solve financial difficulties or recover losses. We are committed to helping Players make informed choices and to providing tools that help them stay in control.
If gambling is no longer enjoyable, is affecting your wellbeing or relationships, or is becoming difficult to control, take a break and use the tools below.
### 2. 
Underage gambling
You must be at least 18 years old to use LIQD. We may ask for proof of age or identity at any time. If we discover that an Account is being used by someone under 18, we will take appropriate action in line with our legal and licence obligations.
### 3. 
Gambling limits
LIQD gives you control over how much you gamble through the Limits section of your Account settings. You can set:
• Wager limits to limit the amount you can bet during a selected period; and
• Loss limits to limit the amount you can lose during a selected period.
The available periods, current limit and any pending change are shown in your Account when you set or change a limit. If you need help using a limit, contact our live support or email support@liqd.bet.
### 4. 
Taking a break and self-exclusion
If you would like a short break from gambling, you can use the self-exclusion tool in your Account. You choose the period that is right for you, from a minimum of 3 hours through to a permanent self-exclusion.
Your self-exclusion begins when you confirm it. While it is active, you cannot play games or place bets with LIQD. You can still log in to your Account and withdraw available funds.
To start a self-exclusion, open your profile menu, select Settings, then Limits, and choose Self Exclusion. Select your preferred period and confirm your choice. If you are unable to use the tool, contact our live support or email support@liqd.bet and our team will help you.
### 5. 
Permanent self-exclusion
If you choose permanent self-exclusion, it has no end date and does not expire automatically. Once it is active, you cannot cancel, shorten, change or reactivate it through your Account or by contacting customer support.
LIQD does not make permanent self-exclusion available for reactivation on demand. We may consider a written request only in exceptional circumstances, including a clear administrative error or where required by applicable law. Any decision is at LIQD's sole discretion and we may refuse a request to lift a permanent self-exclusion. Any approved exception is handled by an authorised super administrator, requires a recorded reason and is audit-logged.
### 6. 
Staying in control
Before you gamble, consider setting a budget that you can afford to lose and deciding how long you want to play. Do not chase losses by increasing your bets. Avoid gambling when you are tired, distressed, intoxicated or under financial pressure.
It may be time to take a break or seek support if you:
• spend more money or time than you planned;
• try to win back losses;
• borrow money to gamble;
• hide your gambling from people close to you; or
• feel anxious, guilty or distressed about gambling.
### 7. 
Support and external resources
If you are concerned about your gambling, contact our live support or email support@liqd.bet. You can also contact independent support organisations directly:
• Gambling Therapy provides free online information, practical advice and emotional support worldwide for people affected by gambling.
• Gamblers Anonymous offers peer-support meetings, including virtual meetings. Its International Service Office can be contacted on +1 909 931 9056; its US National Hotline is 855-222-5542.
• Gam-Anon provides international and virtual peer support for family members, friends and others affected by someone else's gambling.
Blocking software can be a useful extra safeguard. BetBlocker is a free, worldwide tool that can restrict access to gambling services across devices. Gamban is another gambling-blocking tool; its availability and any free access depend on the country or programme through which it is offered.
If you are in immediate danger or feel unable to keep yourself safe, contact local emergency services or an urgent healthcare provider.
### 8. 
How we support safer play
We train relevant team members to recognise responsible-gaming concerns. We may take appropriate action, including applying restrictions to an Account, where we believe gambling may no longer be safe or responsible. We do not market gambling to minors or present gambling as a solution to financial problems or a guaranteed source of income.
### 9. 
Questions and complaints
For help with a limit, self-exclusion or a complaint, contact our live support or email support@liqd.bet. We will acknowledge your complaint within 72 hours and aim to resolve it internally within 30 calendar days. If it remains unresolved, you may refer it to EGIS-ADR, our alternative dispute resolution provider, by email at support@liqd.bet, after completing LIQD's internal complaints process.
### 10. 
Governing law and jurisdiction
To the extent permitted by applicable law, this Policy and any non-contractual obligations arising out of or in connection with it are governed by the laws of the Autonomous Island of Anjouan, Union of Comoros, with exclusive jurisdiction of the Anjouan courts.

name: Provably Fair
text:
# Provably 
Fair
You don’t have to trust us.
We lock in our half of the result before you bet.
When you’re done, we hand it over and you can redo the math yourself.
Verify a Round## Three ingredients
### Server seed
Hidden Until Revealed
A random secret we generate for you. While it’s in use you see only its hash. That hash is our up-front commitment.
### Client seed
Always Visible
Random by default, yours to change to anything. Your control over it is what stops a result being manipulated in advance.
### Nonce
Automatic
A simple counter that ticks up with every bet, so the same pair of seeds never gives the same result twice.
Outcome = Server Seed + Client Seed + Nonce

Combined with HMAC-SHA256. One-way, deterministic, checkable by anyone.
## Play, reveal & verify.
The whole system is one loop. Open the Provably Fair modal on any Originals game to run it.
### Commit
Before you bet
You can see your client seed, the hash of our server seed, and how many bets you’ve made on the pair.
### Play
Each bet takes a nonce
While a server seed is in play, we keep it hidden. If you could see it, you could see your next results too.
### Reveal
When you rotate
We hand over the old server seed in full, and a new one (already hashed) takes its place. To see a seed, you retire it.
### Verify
Anyone, any time
Take a revealed seed pair and a nonce and run them back through. Same inputs, same result, every time.
## One rule.
You can’t rotate and reveal while a game round is still in progress, otherwise you could read the outcome before it’s revealed. Finish the round first.
## We commit first
The hash is published before your first bet and can’t be changed afterwards. When the seed is revealed on rotation, it hashes back to exactly the commitment you were shown.
### Hash of server seed
shown before you bet
2ff2e8260adf6f9582913c897ee8e73224255623c55d40a3dd8060b1ab2cdecd
### Server seed
revealed after rotation
c732c958f6d41e0a7b3549ce8f2b1d64a09e5837cc4b1f2ae6d80935b7c4a1e2
## One engine, read differently
Every Original runs on the same numbers. The only thing that changes is how each game reads them.
### Mines
The numbers shuffle all 25 tiles. The first few in line are your mines.
### Plinko
Each row is one left-or-right call. Count the rights and you’ve got your bucket.
### Blackjack
A fair shuffle fixes every card before the hand begins. Cards are dealt off the top.
## Independently audited
ProvablyFair.org certified.

Our Originals are audited by the Provably Fair Foundation, an independent body that reviews the game logic and certifies operators against a public standard. The verification code behind every result is open-source and reproducible. No black boxes.
Check Audit

## Try it on a real round
Pick a game, paste a revealed pair, and watch your result come back.
Game: Mines
Client Seed

Nonce

Verify a Round

Enter the details, run the round.

The math shows its work.
## Fair by construction
A property of the math.

# Cookie 
Policy

Effective date: 3 August 2026

## 1. 
What this Policy covers
This Cookie Policy explains how LIQD LTD (LIQD, we, us or our) uses cookies and similar technologies on liqd.bet.

It should be read with our [Privacy Policy](?page=privacy-policy) and [Terms of Service](?page=terms-of-service).

## 2. 
What cookies are
Cookies are small text files stored on your device. Similar technologies include local storage, pixels and device identifiers. We use them to operate the Services, keep you signed in, remember preferences, measure performance and help prevent fraud.

## 3. 
Types we use
• **Strictly necessary** — login session, security, load balancing and core site functions.
• **Functional** — language, display preferences and similar settings.
• **Analytics / performance** — how the site is used so we can improve it.
• **Security and fraud prevention** — detect abuse, bots and unauthorised access.

## 4. 
Legal basis
Where required, we rely on your consent for non-essential cookies. Strictly necessary cookies are used because they are needed to provide the Services you request.

## 5. 
Managing cookies
You can control cookies through your browser settings. Blocking some cookies may limit site features (for example staying signed in).

## 6. 
Updates
We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. The effective date above shows the latest version.

## 7. 
Contact
Questions about cookies: [support@liqd.bet](mailto:support@liqd.bet)

# Privacy

### 2. 
Information we collect
#### 2.1 
Personal information we collect
We collect, store and use personal information when you provide it to us, when you use the Services or when it is generated through your Account activity. The information we collect may include:
• Identity information: your full legal name, date of birth and, where required for verification, identity-document information.

• Technical information: your IP address, device and browser information, log data, cookies and similar technology data.

• Verification information: proof of address, payment-method or wallet-control evidence and source-of-funds or source-of-wealth information where required.
• Responsible-gaming information: limits, time-outs, self-exclusion requests and communications about gambling harm.
• Communication records: support chats, emails, complaints, feedback and other communications with us.
We receive most information directly from you or from your use of the Services. We may also receive information from payment providers, game providers, verification or fraud-prevention providers, public sources and competent authorities where lawful.
### 3. 
Why we use personal data
We use personal data where necessary to:
• enter into and perform our contract with you, including operating your Account, processing payments and providing support;

• pursue legitimate interests in securing and improving the Services, preventing fraud and protecting Players, LIQD and third parties, where those interests are not overridden by your rights;
• send marketing where permitted by law and, where required, with your consent; and
• protect vital interests or establish, exercise or defend legal claims where applicable.
You may withdraw consent at any time where we rely on consent. Withdrawal does not affect processing that occurred before it or processing supported by another legal basis.
### 4. 
Who may receive personal data
We may share personal data only where necessary and lawful with the following categories of recipient:
• hosting, platform, security and communications providers;
• identity-verification, AML / KYC, sanctions-screening and fraud-prevention providers;
• payment providers and payment agents involved in receiving, transferring or reconciling payments;
• game providers, where required to operate a game, resolve a wager or meet integrity obligations;
• analytics, consent-management and marketing providers, where permitted;
• professional advisers, auditors, insurers and group companies providing relevant support services; and
• regulators, licensing bodies, courts, law-enforcement agencies and other authorities where required or permitted by law.
We require service providers acting on our behalf to protect personal data and to process it only as necessary to provide services to us, subject to applicable law. Certain payment, game and voucher providers may process personal data as independent controllers where this is necessary to provide their services or meet their own legal or regulatory obligations.
### 5. 
International transfers
LIQD and its service providers may process personal data in countries other than the country where you live. Where required by applicable data-protection law, we put in place the safeguards required for such transfers. You may request further information about relevant processing locations and safeguards by contacting support@liqd.bet.
### 6. 
Retention
We keep personal data only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, including legal, regulatory, licensing, accounting, dispute-resolution and security requirements.
AML-related records and relevant transaction records are retained for at least five years, and longer where required by law, licence conditions or a legitimate need to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.
### 7. 
Security
We use reasonable organisational and technical measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, alteration and disclosure. No method of internet transmission or electronic storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
### 8. 
Your rights and choices
Depending on the law that applies to you, you may have rights to request access to, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of personal data; object to certain processing; and withdraw consent. You may also have a right to complain to a relevant data-protection authority.
To make a request, contact our live support or email support@liqd.bet. We may ask for information needed to verify your identity before responding. Some requests may be limited where we must retain data or processing is otherwise permitted or required by law.
You can opt out of marketing using the unsubscribe link in a marketing message or by contacting us. Service, security, compliance and transaction communications are not marketing and may still be sent where necessary.
### 9. 
Cookies and similar technologies
We use cookies and similar technologies as described in our Cookie Policy. Analytics technologies are used only where permitted by law and the applicable consent setting. You can manage non-essential technology through the cookie settings available on the Website. Essential technology may remain necessary for the Services to function securely.
### 10. 
Underage persons
The Services are not intended for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly permit an underage person to create or use an Account. If we learn that an Account is associated with an underage person, we take appropriate protective action under our legal and licence obligations. If you believe that an underage person has provided us with personal data, contact support@liqd.bet.

Automated decisions
We may use automated tools to support fraud prevention, security, compliance and responsible-gaming processes. Where an automated decision has a material effect and applicable law requires it, we will provide the information and review route required by that law.

Changes and contact
We may update this Policy to reflect changes to our Services, legal requirements or processing practices. We will publish the revised version and provide further notice where required.

# AML & KYC 
Policy
Effective date: 3 August 2026

Purpose
LIQD is committed to preventing money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions breaches and other financial crime. We use a risk-based AML / CTF programme designed to meet applicable law, licence conditions and regulatory requirements. This Policy explains why we may ask for information or documents, delay a transaction or restrict an Account.
### 2. 
Customer due diligence
We apply customer due diligence measures as part of our customer registration procedures and throughout the customer relationship.
Before an Account is activated, we collect and record:
• your full legal name;
• a valid email address;
• your date of birth; and
• your residential address.
We may use the information you provide, together with information from trusted third-party providers, to carry out age, identity, sanctions, politically exposed person (PEP) and other compliance checks where required.
At any time, including where your risk profile changes or we identify a red flag, we may carry out enhanced due diligence and request additional information or documents. This may include:
• government-issued identification;
• proof of residential address;
• payment-method or wallet-control information; and
• evidence of source of funds or source of wealth.
You must provide information and documents that are accurate, complete and current when requested. Our handling of personal data is described in the Privacy Policy.
### 3. 
When we may verify you
We may carry out verification at any time, including when you make a withdrawal request, where the value or pattern of activity reaches a compliance review point, where Account information changes, or where we identify elevated risk or unusual activity.
Depending on the circumstances, we may request:
• government-issued photo identification;
• a utility bill or other reliable proof of residential address;
• confirmation that you control a payment method or cryptoasset wallet; and
• information or evidence about the source of funds or source of wealth.
We may use service providers to help perform checks. Where a provider is involved, LIQD remains responsible for its own compliance obligations.
### 4. 
Enhanced due diligence
Enhanced due diligence may be required where activity presents a higher risk. This may include a first withdrawal request, significant or unusual activity, a change in risk profile, sanctions or politically exposed person considerations, or information suggesting unlawful activity.
If we request source-of-funds or source-of-wealth information, you must respond truthfully within the stated timeframe. We request only information reasonably relevant to the review and handle it in accordance with our Privacy Policy and applicable retention obligations.
### 5. 
Monitoring and screening
We monitor Account and transaction activity on a risk-sensitive basis to identify potential financial crime, fraud, manipulation or other prohibited conduct. This may include screening against applicable sanctions and other legally relevant sources, reviewing transaction patterns and investigating unusual activity.
We do not publish detailed monitoring rules, thresholds or investigative methods, as that could weaken the effectiveness of our safeguards.
